title: Onboard apollo-13b v1.1: metadata, perf profiles, and changelog automation
description:
This PR onboards apollo-13b v1.1 into the model registry and adds automated perf profiles + changelog/release-notes generation for the model. Motivation: apollo-13b v1.1 is a patched weight release with improved decoder caching and quantization compatibility; we need correct metadata, validated performance profiles for our supported hardware families, and an automated changelog entry so Console and SDKs can surface the release.

What this PR does (high level):
- Adds canonical model metadata (model-metadata/apollo-13b/v1.1/metadata.json) including architecture, tokenizer hints, recommended max_length, and recommended quantization knobs.
- Adds performance profiles (perf-profiles/apollo-13b-v1.1.yaml) with throughput/latency samples for common sequence lengths on supported instance types (A100-80GB, A10G, T4) and single-GPU/multi-GPU configs. Profiles generated from perf-lab runs and include batch/latency SLO guidance.
- Adds a small perf regression test (tests/perf/test_apollo_13b_profile.py) that validates inference throughput/latency are within expected ranges on CI perf hardware (skipped on standard CI agents).
- Extends the changelog automation script to pick up onboarded model metadata and synthesize a release note entry when a metadata file contains a "release_notes" field (scripts/changelog/generate_release_notes.py).
- Small docs: redwood-docs/models/apollo-13b.md stub and examples in redwood-examples/model-demos/apollo-13b.

Testing and validation:
- Local perf runs and lab runs on perf-canary clusters used to produce the YAML profile values (referenced in commit messages).
- Unit tests for changelog generator added and green (scripts/changelog/test_generate_release_notes.py).
- CI: unit + lint + integration (model-registry) pass in main CI; perf tests are gated and ran on perf infra.

Rollout plan:
1) Merge to main.
2) Release notes entry is auto-generated and surfaced in next release pipeline; Console will pick up the new perf profile once deployed.
3) Monitor perf-regression alerts for the next 48 hours after rollout.

Checklist:
- [x] Metadata JSON validated against schema
- [x] Perf profiles added and validated against perf-lab outputs
- [x] Changelog generator extended and unit-tested
- [x] Docs stub + example added

Notes:
- This PR intentionally pins the sample numbers with timestamps in the YAML to make traceability easier.
- No breaking API changes.

References: Linear ENG-4217 (model onboarding), PM-998 (release coordination).
